edges.description: Colonizing wall-less bacteria persist on the mucosal surface while hydrolyzing host urea and exposing variable surface antigens.
edges.target: Ureaplasma Urea Catabolism and Surface Persistence

edges.description: Colonizing U. urealyticum expresses human IgA1 protease at the same mucosal surface where secretory IgA1 is part of host containment.
Higher U. urealyticum biovar 2 burden is associated with symptomatic urethritis; the exact bacterial and host intermediates from load to polymorphonuclear inflammation remain incompletely resolved.
Inflamed anterior urethral mucosa produces painful urination and urethral discomfort.
Neutrophil-rich mucosal inflammation produces visible urethral exudate.

edges.source: Doxycycline or Azithromycin for Nongonococcal Urethritis

nodes.description: Doxycycline and azithromycin are standard small-molecule regimens for symptomatic nongonococcal urethritis; in an NGU randomized trial that tested for U. urealyticum biovar 2, microbiologic cure of UU-2 was similar with azithromycin and doxycycline.
nodes.id: Doxycycline or Azithromycin for Nongonococcal Urethritis

evidence.reference_title: Standard treatment regimens for nongonococcal urethritis have similar but declining cure rates: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence.snippet: Participants received active azithromycin (1 g) + placebo doxycycline or active doxycycline (100 mg twice daily for 7 days) + placebo azithromycin.

evidence.reference_title: Standard treatment regimens for nongonococcal urethritis have similar but declining cure rates: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence.snippet: In pathogen-specific analyses, clinical cure did not differ by arm, nor did microbiologic cure differ for CT (86% vs 90%, P = .56), MG (40% vs 30%, P = .41), or UU-2 (75% vs 70%, P = .50).

nodes.description: Painful urination is one of the typical symptomatic manifestations of nongonococcal urethritis.

evidence.snippet: Urethritis is characterized by discharge, dysuria and/or urethral discomfort but may be asymptomatic.

nodes.description: Sexually acquired U. urealyticum colonizes the anterior urethral mucosa; only some colonized men develop urethritis, and organism burden appears to distinguish pathogenic infection from low-grade carriage.

evidence.reference_title: Quantitative detection of Ureaplasma parvum (biovar 1) and Ureaplasma urealyticum (biovar 2) in urine specimens from men with and without urethritis by real-time polymerase chain reaction.
evidence.snippet: U. urealyticum (biovar 2) loads in 23 men with NMNCNGU were significantly higher than those in 14 men without urethritis.

evidence.reference_title: Aetiology and prevalence of mixed-infections and mono-infections in non-gonococcal urethritis in men: a case-control study.
evidence.snippet: UU monoinfections were more common in controls, in younger men and in men with no history of NGU.

nodes.description: Urethral infection is defined by excess polymorphonuclear leukocytes in the anterior urethra and causes the irritative symptoms and discharge of nongonococcal urethritis.

evidence.snippet: The diagnosis should be confirmed with microscopy of a stained smear from urethra, demonstrating an excess of polymorphonuclear leucocytes (PMNLs) or monocytes in the anterior urethra

nodes.description: U. urealyticum secretes a human IgA1 protease that cleaves the IgA1 heavy chain hinge into Fab and Fc fragments, plausibly reducing secretory IgA1 containment at the urethral surface.

evidence.reference_title: Characterization of the immunoglobulin A protease of Ureaplasma urealyticum.
evidence.snippet: Ureaplasma urealyticum strains of all serotypes express a specific human immunoglobulin A1 protease that cleaves immunoglobulin A1 to produce intact Fab and Fc fragments.

nodes.description: Ureaplasma organisms generate ATP by hydrolyzing urea and carry a phase-variable multiple-banded-antigen surface system that can vary exposed antigenic epitopes during mucosal persistence.
nodes.id: Ureaplasma Urea Catabolism and Surface Persistence

evidence.reference_title: Comparative genome analysis of 19 Ureaplasma urealyticum and Ureaplasma parvum strains.
evidence.snippet: comprising those members of the family Mycoplasmataceae that hydrolyze urea and use it as a metabolic substrate for generation of ATP.

evidence.reference_title: Comparative genome analysis of 19 Ureaplasma urealyticum and Ureaplasma parvum strains.
evidence.snippet: Whole genome analysis of the 14 serovars and the 4 clinical isolates showed the mba gene was part of a large superfamily, which is a phase variable gene system

nodes.description: Urethral inflammatory exudate can be visible clinically in men with nongonococcal urethritis.

evidence.snippet: Urethritis is characterized by discharge, dysuria and/or urethral discomfort but may be asymptomatic.
